United States.summary: Gunman opens fire at a LGBTQ bar in South Florida, killing 2 and injuring 9 others.
Federal agents arrest 18 people for allegedly planning to attack schools, infrastructure targets, and government facilities in the United States.
A group of armed men storms a bank in California, leading to a standoff with the police and the release of several hostages.

South Korea.title: North Korea fires ballistic missile off eastern coast, triggering warning siren in South Korea
South Korea.summary: A ballistic missile was fired from North Korea's east coast direction towards the Japanese coast, prompting an alert in South Korea. Japanese authorities detected the missile after it flew into Japanese airspace

South Korea.title: South Korea's parliament passes law banning dog meat consumption
South Korea.summary: South Korea's National Assembly has passed a bill banning the trade and consumption of dog meat. Opponents fear this may be another example of foreign influence eroding the country's unique cultural habits.

South Korea.title: South Korea reports record number of COVID-19 cases as Omicron spreads
South Korea.summary: South Korea is facing a surge in COVID-19 cases as the highly contagious Omicron variant continues to spread. Cases have been detected across the country, prompting concerns about the potential for another wave of infections.

Japan.title: North Korea fires ballistic missile over Japan
Japan.summary: North Korea fired a ballistic missile into the Sea of Japan early on August 5, 2022, causing a significant emergency alert to sound in Japan and prompting a US aircraft carrier to sail into the area.

Japan.title: Japanese PM Kishida to visit US for Quad summit
Japan.summary: Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida will visit the United States in May 2022 to participate in a summit of the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue, or Quad, along with leaders of the US, Australia, and India.

Japan.title: US, Japan, South Korea launch joint military exercise
Japan.summary: The United States, Japan, and South Korea have launched a joint military exercise in waters east of South Korea, with the goal of improving the allies' military readiness and interoperability.
